disclosure: No AMD GPU was present on the measuring host unless is_gpu_active is true. mi300x_transfer_lower_bound_seconds is a theoretical roofline lower-bound estimate, not measured. Formula: lower_bound_seconds = (working_set_mb * 1024 * 1024) / (5.3e12). working_set_mb is the tracemalloc peak already stored on the matching samples row of results/bench.json. src/engine/benchmark.py:_measure_working_set_mb records peak bytes during solver.solve and divides by (1024 * 1024). This script does not re-time the CPU. 5.3 TB/s max. peak theoretical (https://www.amd.com/content/dam/amd/en/documents/instinct-tech-docs/data-sheets/amd-instinct-mi300x-data-sheet.pdf). Up to 192 GB HBM3. Do not divide the bound by cpu_seconds to claim a speedup.
